scripts.check: npm run check --workspaces --if-present && biome check . && npm run pi:check
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:python
scripts.test:python: uv run --project python/jouzu python -m unittest discover -s python/jouzu/tests -v
scripts.dev:link: npm run build && npm link --workspace packages/cli
scripts.pi:check:online: node scripts/pi-upstream.mjs check --online && node scripts/pi-upstream.mjs latest --require-latest
scripts.pi:qualify: npm run pi:check:online && npm run release:check && node scripts/pi-upstream.mjs promote
scripts.release:check: npm run release:metadata && npm run build && npm run check && npm test && npm run pack:check && npm run test:packed && npm run build:python && npm run check:python
